8.7.3.2.1 ReadData
If DcmDspDataUsePort is set to USE_DATA_SYNCH_CLIENT_SERVER or USE_-
DATA_SYNCH_FNC, the following definition is used:

Xxx_ReadData

uint8* Data
)
Service ID [hex]
0x34
Sync/Async
Synchronous

None

None

Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: this value is always returned.
Description
This function requests to the application a data value of a DID/PID if DcmDspDataUsePort is
set to USE_DATA_SYNCH_CLIENT_SERVER.
